root_cause_label: OpenHands Venv Python/Pip Mismatch Exhausts Step Budget Before Output Saved
one_sentence_failure_summary: The OpenHands venv's python3 (/opt/openhands-venv/bin/python3) lacked scipy in its sys.path despite multiple pip and apt installs, consuming 24 of 26 steps on environment debugging, and when the PYTHONPATH workaround finally worked at step 26 the script did not write the required solution.txt output file.
t_err_evidence: python3 optimization.py run without verifying which Python env is active; ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'scipy'
t_commit_evidence: By step 7, the agent has tried pip install (step 4), apt-get install (step 6), and run python3 optimization.py three times (steps 3, 5, 7) — all failing with the same ModuleNotFoundError. No pip module exists in the venv, the venv has no scipy, and the step budget is being consumed. From step 7 onward the agent is locked into iterative shell-script workaround attempts with no clear path to resolution within the remaining budget, making the failing outcome locked in.
t_surface_evidence: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'scipy' at first script execution
trigger_explanation: At step 4 the agent ran 'pip install scipy' and saw 'Requirement already satisfied: scipy in /usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages'. The agent misread this as confirmation that scipy was now available to python3, without recognizing that 'which python3' would show /opt/openhands-venv/bin/python3 — a different interpreter whose sys.path does not include /usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages. This misreading led to the same failed invocation at step 5 and subsequent thrashing.
forewarning_evidence: Requirement already satisfied: scipy in /usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages — yet error persists
